mergeStrategy.description:
MergeStrategy controls precedence when multiple values files are listed under `values`.

"override" (default): later files override earlier files (the historical helmfile behavior).
"fallback":           earlier files take precedence; later files only fill gaps.

Under the "fallback" strategy, an explicit non-nil value in an earlier file (including
the zero values false, 0, "", and empty list) is preserved against any later file. Maps
are deep-merged, so an earlier map does not block later files from adding nested keys.
An explicit null in an earlier file falls through to a later file's value (matching how
helmfile's MergeMaps treats nil from the override side elsewhere). Subsequent .gotmpl
values files can also reference values from earlier files via .Values.

missingFileHandler.description:
MissingFileHandler instructs helmfile to fail when unable to find a environment values file listed
under `environments.NAME.values`.

Possible values are  "Error", "Warn", "Info", "Debug". The default is "Error".

Use "Warn", "Info", or "Debug" if you want helmfile to not fail when a values file is missing, while just leaving
a message about the missing file at the log-level.

cascade.description: Cascade '--cascade' to helmv3 delete, available values: background, foreground, or orphan, default: background

cleanupOnFail.description: CleanupOnFail, when set to true, the --cleanup-on-fail helm flag is passed to the upgrade command

createNamespace.description: CreateNamespace, when set to true (default), --create-namespace is passed to helm on install/upgrade

deleteTimeout.description: Timeout is the time in seconds to wait for helmfile delete command (default 300)

deleteWait.description: Wait, if set to true, will wait until all resources are deleted before mark delete command as successful

devel.description: Devel, when set to true, use development versions, too. Equivalent to version '>0.0.0-0'

disableAutoDetectedKubeVersionForDiff.description:
DisableAutoDetectedKubeVersionForDiff controls whether auto-detected kubeVersion should be passed
to helm diff. When false (default), auto-detected kubeVersion is passed to fix issue #2275.
Set to true to only pass explicit kubeVersion from helmfile.yaml, preventing helm-diff from
normalizing server-side defaults which could hide real changes (e.g., ipFamilyPolicy, ipFamilies).

enableDNS.description: EnableDNS, when set to true, enable DNS lookups when rendering templates

force.description: Force, when set to true, forces resource update through delete/recreate if needed

forceConflicts.description: ForceConflicts, when set to true, force server-side apply changes against conflicts (Helm 4 only)

helmStuckGrace.description:
HelmStuckGrace, when > 0, enables the helmfile-side safety-valve
helm-killer for releases using --track-mode kubedog. See
ReleaseSpec.HelmStuckGrace for semantics.

historyMax.description: HistoryMax, limit the maximum number of revisions saved per release. Use 0 for no limit (default 10)

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: InsecureSkipTLSVerify is true if the TLS verification should be skipped when fetching remote chart

plainHttp.description: PlainHttp is true if the remote charte should be fetched using HTTP and not HTTPS

postRenderer.description: Propagate '--post-renderer' to helmv3 template and helm install

postRendererArgs.description: Propagate '--post-renderer-args' to helmv3 template and helm install

recreatePods.description: RecreatePods, when set to true, instruct helmfile to perform pods restart for the resource if applicable

reuseValues.description: on helm upgrade/diff, reuse values currently set in the release and merge them with the ones defined within helmfile

rollbackOnFailure.description:
RollbackOnFailure, when set to true, restores previous state on a failed install/upgrade via the
Helm 4 --rollback-on-failure flag (the successor to the deprecated --atomic flag). Requires Helm 4 or greater.

serverSide.description: ServerSide controls the helm 4 --server-side flag for upgrade. Must be "true", "false", or "auto".

skipCRDs.description:
SkipCRDs passes the --skip-crds flag to helm upgrade --install to ensure any CRDs contained in the crds/
subdirectory of a helm chart are not automatically applied with every helmfile sync or apply

skipDeps.description:
SkipDeps disables running `helm dependency up` and `helm dependency build` on this release's chart.
This is relevant only when your release uses a local chart or a directory containing K8s manifests or a Kustomization
as a Helm chart.

skipSchemaValidation.description: Propagate '--skip-schema-validation' to helmv3 template and helm install

suppressOutputLineRegex.description: SuppressOutputLineRegex is a list of regexes to suppress output lines

syncReleaseLabels.description: SyncReleaseLabels is true if the release labels should be synced with the helmfile labels

takeOwnership.description: TakeOwnership is true if the helmfile should take ownership of the release

templateArgs.description:
TemplateArgs are extra args appended to the helm template / helm diff rendering
(e.g. "--dry-run=server" to enable the helm lookup function). Overridden by the
--template-args CLI flag on a per-invocation basis.

timeout.description: Timeout is the time in seconds to wait for any individual Kubernetes operation (like Jobs for hooks, and waits on pod/pvc/svc/deployment readiness) (default 300)

trackMode.description: TrackMode specifies whether to use 'helm' or 'kubedog' for tracking resources

wait.description: Wait, if set to true, will wait until all Pods, PVCs, Services, and minimum number of Pods of a Deployment are in a ready state before marking the release as successful

waitForJobs.description: WaitForJobs, if set and --wait enabled, will wait until all Jobs have been completed before marking the release as successful. It will wait for as long as --timeout

waitRetries.description:
WaitRetries, if set and --wait enabled, will retry any failed check on resource state, except if HTTP status code < 500 is received, subject to the specified number of retries
DEPRECATED: This field is ignored as the --wait-retries flag was removed from Helm. Preserved for backward compatibility.

ignoreMissingGitBranch.description:
IgnoreMissingGitBranch is set to true in order to let the missing file handler
treat missing git branch errors like `pathspec 'develop' did not match any file(s) known to git` safe
and ignored when the handler is set to Warn or Info.

atomic.description: Atomic, when set to true, restore previous state in case of a failed install/upgrade attempt

cascade.description: Cascade '--cascade' to helmv3 delete, available values: background, foreground, or orphan, default: background

chart.description: Chart is the name of the chart being installed to create this release

chartPath.description:
ChartPath is the downloaded and modified version of the remote Chart specified by the Chart field.
This field is empty when the release is going to use the remote chart as-is, without any modifications(e.g. chartify).

cleanupOnFail.description: CleanupOnFail, when set to true, the --cleanup-on-fail helm flag is passed to the upgrade command

condition.description: Condition, when set, evaluate the mapping specified in this string to a boolean which decides whether or not to process the release

createNamespace.description: CreateNamespace, when set to true (default), --create-namespace is passed to helm on install

deleteTimeout.description: Timeout is the time in seconds to wait for helmfile delete command (default 300)

deleteWait.description: --wait flag for destroy/delete, if set to true, will wait until all resources are deleted before mark delete command as successful

dependencies.description: These settings requires helm-x integration to work

description.description: Description is the description for this release that will be passed to helm upgrade with --description flag

devel.description: Devel, when set to true, use development versions, too. Equivalent to version '>0.0.0-0'

directory.description:
Directory is an alias to Chart which may be of more fit when you want to use a local/remote directory containing
K8s manifests or Kustomization as a chart

disableAutoDetectedKubeVersionForDiff.description:
DisableAutoDetectedKubeVersionForDiff controls whether auto-detected kubeVersion should be passed
to helm diff for this release. See HelmSpec.DisableAutoDetectedKubeVersionForDiff for details.

disableOpenAPIValidation.description:
DisableOpenAPIValidation is rarely used to bypass OpenAPI validations only that is used for e.g.
work-around against broken CRs
See also:
- https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/6819
- https://github.com/roboll/helmfile/issues/1167

disableValidation.description:
DisableValidation is rarely used to bypass the whole validation of manifests against the Kubernetes cluster
so that `helm diff` can be run containing a chart that installs both CRD and CRs on first install.
FYI, such diff without `--disable-validation` fails on first install because the K8s cluster doesn't have CRDs registered yet.

disableValidationOnInstall.description:
DisableValidationOnInstall disables the K8s API validation while running helm-diff on the release being newly installed on helmfile-apply.
It is useful when any release contains custom resources for CRDs that is not yet installed onto the cluster.

enableDNS.description: EnableDNS, when set to true, enable DNS lookups when rendering templates

env.description: The 'env' section is not really necessary any longer, as 'set' would now provide the same functionality

force.description: Force, when set to true, forces resource update through delete/recreate if needed

forceConflicts.description: ForceConflicts, when set to true, force server-side apply changes against conflicts (Helm 4 only)

forceGoGetter.description:
ForceGoGetter forces the use of go-getter for fetching remote directory as maniefsts/chart/kustomization
by parsing the url from `chart` field of the release.
This is handy when getting the go-getter url parsing error when it doesn't work as expected.
Without this, any error in url parsing result in silently falling-back to normal process of treating `chart:` as the regular
helm chart name.

forceNamespace.description:
ForceNamespace is an experimental feature to set metadata.namespace in every K8s resource rendered by the chart,
regardless of the template, even when it doesn't have `namespace: {{ .Namespace | quote }}`.
This is only needed when you can't FIX your chart to have `namespace: {{ .Namespace }}` AND you're using `helmfile template`.
In standard use-cases, `Namespace` should be sufficient.
Use this only when you know what you want to do!

helmStuckGrace.description:
HelmStuckGrace, when > 0, enables the safety-valve helm-killer for
kubedog tracking: if the cluster confirms every tracked resource has
converged but the helm subprocess is still running, helmfile waits
this many seconds before sending SIGINT to helm. Targets the helm v4
hook waiter wedge that --track-timeout would otherwise resolve only
after hours. Zero (or absent) disables the killer.

inherit.description: Inherit is used to inherit a release template from a release or another release template

installed.description: Installed, when set to true, `delete --purge` the release

kubedogBurst.description: KubedogBurst specifies the burst for kubedog kubernetes client

kubedogQPS.description: KubedogQPS specifies the QPS (queries per second) for kubedog kubernetes client

missingFileHandler.description:
MissingFileHandler is set to either "Error" or "Warn". "Error" instructs helmfile to fail when unable to find a values or secrets file. When "Warn", it prints the file and continues.
The default value for MissingFileHandler is "Error".

needs.description: Needs is the [KUBECONTEXT/][NS/]NAME representations of releases that this release depends on.

RollbackOnFailure, when set to true, restores previous state on a failed install/upgrade via the

serverSide.description: ServerSide controls the helm 4 --server-side flag for this release. Must be "true", "false", or "auto".

skipDeps.description:
SkipDeps disables running `helm dependency up` and `helm dependency build` on this release's chart.
This is relevant only when your release uses a local chart or a directory containing K8s manifests or a Kustomization
as a Helm chart.

skipKinds.description: SkipKinds is a blacklist of resource kinds to skip tracking

skipSchemaValidation.description: Propagate '--skip-schema-validation' to helmv3 template and helm install

suppressDiff.description: SuppressDiff skip the helm diff output. Useful for charts which produces large not helpful diff.

suppressOutputLineRegex.description: SuppressOutputLineRegex is a list of regexes to suppress output lines

syncReleaseLabels.description: SyncReleaseLabels is true if the release labels should be synced with the helmfile labels

takeOwnership.description: TakeOwnership is true if release should take ownership of resources

timeout.description: Timeout is the time in seconds to wait for any individual Kubernetes operation (like Jobs for hooks, and waits on pod/pvc/svc/deployment readiness) (default 300)

trackFailOnError.description: TrackFailOnError controls whether kubedog tracking failures cause a non-zero exit code

trackFailedLogs.description:
TrackFailedLogs streams logs only for pods that enter a failed state
(CrashLoopBackOff, Error, etc.). Pods that succeed produce no output.
Has no effect when TrackLogs is true (full streaming wins).

trackKinds.description: TrackKinds is a whitelist of resource kinds to track

trackLogs.description: TrackLogs enables log streaming with kubedog

trackMode.description: TrackMode specifies whether to use 'helm' or 'kubedog' for tracking resources

trackResources.description: TrackResources is a whitelist of specific resources to track

trackTimeout.description: TrackTimeout specifies timeout for kubedog tracking (in seconds)

transformers.description:
Transformers is the list of Kustomize transformers

Each item can be a path to a YAML or go template file, or an embedded transformer declaration as a YAML hash.
It's often used to add common labels and annotations to your resources.
See https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/blob/master/examples/configureBuiltinPlugin.md#configuring-the-builtin-plugins-instead for more information.

unitTests.description:
UnitTests is a list of test file or directory paths for helm-unittest integration.
When specified, `helmfile unittest` will run `helm unittest` with the merged values and these test paths.

updateStrategy.description: UpdateStrategy, when set, indicate the strategy to use to update the release

verify.description:
Verify enables signature verification on fetched chart.
Beware some (or many?) chart repositories and charts don't seem to support it.

verifyTemplate.description: These values are used in templating

version.description: Version is the semver version or version constraint for the chart

wait.description: Wait, if set to true, will wait until all Pods, PVCs, Services, and minimum number of Pods of a Deployment are in a ready state before marking the release as successful

waitForJobs.description: WaitForJobs, if set and --wait enabled, will wait until all Jobs have been completed before marking the release as successful. It will wait for as long as --timeout

waitRetries.description:
WaitRetries, if set and --wait enabled, will retry any failed check on resource state, except if HTTP status code < 500 is received, subject to the specified number of retries
DEPRECATED: This field is ignored as the --wait-retries flag was removed from Helm. Preserved for backward compatibility.

inherits.description:
Inherits is the list of parent-helmfile config categories this
sub-helmfile inherits. Allowed values are listed in AllowedInherits
(repositories, helmDefaults, commonLabels, apiVersions, kubeVersion,
templates, environments). Child values win; parent fills gaps. See
MergeInherited. Empty (the default) preserves the historical behavior
where sub-helmfiles are independent.

path.description: path or glob pattern for the sub helmfiles

selectors.description: chosen selectors for the sub helmfiles

selectorsInherited.description: do the sub helmfiles inherits from parent selectors

bases.description: List of base helmfile YAML files layered under this one before rendering.

chart.description: Override the chart used by all releases in this helmfile.

commonLabels.description: Labels applied to all releases in this helmfile. Useful when templating a helmfile per environment or customer to avoid copying the same label onto each release.

defaultInherit.description: Default release templates that every release inherits from, unless overridden per release with `inherit`.

environments.description: The environments managed by this helmfile, keyed by environment name.

helmBinary.description: Path to an alternative helm binary (--helm-binary).

helmDefaults.description: Default settings applied to every release, unless overridden on the release itself.

helmfiles.description: Sub-helmfiles to run, each given as a path/glob string or a sub-helmfile object.

hooks.description: Hooks is a list of extension points paired with operations, that are executed in specific points of the lifecycle of releases defined in helmfile

kubeContext.description: Override the kube-context used by all releases (--kube-context).

kustomizeBinary.description: Path to an alternative kustomize binary.

llm.$comment: UNDOCUMENTED. OpenAI-compatible config for AI-assisted subcommands such as `helmfile doctor`.
llm.description:
LLM is the optional OpenAI-compatible configuration used by AI-assisted
subcommands such as `helmfile doctor`. When absent (the default),
those commands degrade to their non-AI equivalents (e.g. plain `diff`).
This field is read at app layer; the state layer treats it as inert.

apiKey.description:
APIKey authenticates against BaseURL. May be templated in helmfile.yaml
via {{ env "KEY" }}.

baseURL.description:
BaseURL is the OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, e.g.
"https://one-api.internal/v1" or "https://api.deepseek.com/v1".
When empty, defaults to "https://api.openai.com/v1".

maxTokens.description: MaxTokens caps the completion length. Defaults to 4096 when zero.

model.description:
Model is the chat completion model identifier, e.g. "gpt-4o",
"claude-3-5-sonnet" (via gateway), "deepseek-chat".

temperature.description:
Temperature controls generation randomness. Defaults to 0.2 when zero
(deterministic-ish for risk analysis).

timeout.description: Timeout is the per-request timeout. Defaults to 60s when zero.

lockFilePath.description: Path to the dependency lock file (defaults to helmfile.lock next to the helmfile).

missingFileHandler.description:
If set to "Error", return an error when a subhelmfile points to a
non-existent path. The default behavior is to print a warning. Note the
differing default compared to other MissingFileHandlers.

missingFileHandlerConfig.description: MissingFileHandlerConfig is composed of various settings for the MissingFileHandler

namespace.description: Override the namespace used by all releases (--namespace).

releases.description: Releases that helmfile converges to the desired state via helm commands.

repositories.description: Helm chart repositories available to the releases in this helmfile.

templates.description: Reusable release templates, referenced by name via `inherit` or `defaultInherit`.

values.description: DefaultValues is the default values to be overrode by environment values and command-line overrides
